According to DAR filed in both the cases, on 04.03.2021, Smt. Bimla (deceased in MACP No.
399/21) alongwith Smt. Krishna (injured in connected MACP No. 398/21) and some other persons,
were returning to their home in Eeco car bearing registration no. HRQ1-AU-6680 (offending vehicle).

At about 12:15 am, when they reached on SRHC Road, Near Ramleela Ground, Narela,
Delhi, the driver of the aforesaid Eeco car which was being driven by him at a very high speed, in a rash and negligent manner, hit the divider, as a result of which, the said vehicle turned turtle on the road, due to which both the aforesaid persons alongwith other persons sustained injuries and Smt.
Bimla died due to the injuries suffered by her.
They were taken to SRHC Hospital, Narela, Delhi.
FIR No. 64/21 u/s. 279/337/304A IPC was registered at PS. Narela with regard to the said accident.
It is claimed that offending vehicle was owned by respondent no. 2 and was insured with New India Assurance Co. Ltd./respondent no. 3 during the period in question.

In their identical but separate Written Statements filed in both the cases, the respondent no. 1 & 2 i.e. driver and registered owner have claimed that the accident in question did not occur due to rash and negligent driving of offending vehicle by respondent no. 1.
